sections.title: Introduction: The Dimensional Paradox
lecture_lines: Can a 1D line fill a 2D square?
A space-filling curve traverses every point.
Imagine a vacuum cleaning a room.

sections.title: The Mechanism: Recursive Construction

Iteratively replace segments to fill space.

sections.title: Visualizing the Mapping (1D to 2D)
lecture_lines: As iterations increase, the curve densifies.
A single thread covers the entire plane.
Infinite iterations result in a filled square.
Dimensions collapse into a continuous path.
